num_demand_sites: <int> Number of customer demand sites in the supply chain network.
num_production_sites: <int> Number of production sites where modular manufacturing units can be stationed.
num_scenarios: <int> Number of demand scenarios representing possible future realizations of customer demand.
num_time_periods: <int> Number of time periods in the planning horizon.
num_module_sizes: <int> Number of available manufacturing module sizes.
units_per_module_size: <int> Maximum number of individual manufacturing units that can be purchased for each module size.
u_max: <float> Global maximum total production allowed at any single production site in any period.
scenario_probabilities: <list[float], length num_scenarios> Probability of each demand scenario occurring.

demand_sites.id: <int> Zero-based index identifying this demand site.
demand_sites.x: <float> Horizontal coordinate of the demand site location.
demand_sites.y: <float> Vertical coordinate of the demand site location.

production_sites.id: <int> Zero-based index identifying this production site.
production_sites.x: <float> Horizontal coordinate of the production site location.
production_sites.y: <float> Vertical coordinate of the production site location.

module_sizes.id: <int> Zero-based index identifying this module size category.
module_sizes.name: <str> Descriptive name of this module size category.
module_sizes.capacity: <float> Amount of demand a single unit of this module size can serve per time period when stationed at a production site.
module_sizes.capital_cost_per_unit: <float> One-time purchase cost for acquiring a single manufacturing unit of this module size.

module_units.module_size_id: <int> Module size category this unit belongs to.
module_units.unit_id: <int> Index of this individual unit within its module size category.
module_units.capital_cost: <float> One-time purchase cost for acquiring this specific manufacturing unit.

production_costs: <list[list[float]], shape [num_demand_sites][num_production_sites]> Per-unit cost of serving demand at each demand site from each production site.
relocation_costs: <list[list[list[float]]], shape [num_production_sites][num_production_sites][num_module_sizes]> Cost of relocating one manufacturing unit of each module size between each ordered pair of production sites.
penalty_costs: <list[list[float]], shape [num_demand_sites][num_time_periods]> Penalty cost per unit of demand left unserved at each demand site in each time period.

scenarios.id: <int> Zero-based index identifying this demand scenario.
scenarios.probability: <float> Probability of this demand scenario occurring.
scenarios.demands: <list[list[float]], shape [num_demand_sites][num_time_periods]> Customer demand quantity at each demand site in each time period under this scenario.
